extraction.Name: John Conoyer
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I traded my quarter for another quarter
extraction.Buyer: traded with my mother for the land she received a patent to without asking for the patent
extraction.NOTES: Patent was mailed to him; does not remember the date but it was at the time others were getting their patents; thinks he signed a receipt for it; traded his allotment quarter for another quarter from his mother; new land is clear except 1928 taxes; has never mortgaged it; not married; satisfied with the trade; notarized May 2, 1929 by Jas. W. Ross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32
